2610.06703.title: Reading the Mood: Emotion-Guided Book-to-Music Recommendation via CGANs and LLMs
2610.06703.paper_summary: Background music that matches the mood of a text has been shown to make readers feel more immersed and improve their reading experience, motivating recommender systems that pair books with mood-matched music. In this direction, we present Sentiment Aware Generative Adversarial Network for Cross Domain Recommendation (SAGA-CDR), a two-phase cross-domain recommendation framework that personalizes music suggestions and emotionally aligns them with the book being read. In the first phase, transformer-based sentiment embeddings are constructed from user reviews and mapped across domains via a Conditional Generative Adversarial Network, whose mask-conditioned generator handles missing sentiment components and injects stochasticity for richer preference transfer. A compact rating neural network then fuses sentiment-specific interaction scores with a collaborative filtering prior to predict music ratings. In the second phase, large language models classify each book into a valence-arousal emotional quadrant, and candidate tracks are filtered to match that quadrant. Experiments on both the English Amazon and Chinese Douban datasets show that SAGA-CDR achieves the best rating prediction accuracy on Amazon (RMSE 0.98) and the lowest RMSE on Douban (0.91), with ranking performance competitive with the strongest sentiment-aware baseline, even in cross-lingual settings.
2610.06703.paper_summary_zh: 背景音樂與文本情緒相符已被證明能使讀者感到更沉浸，並改善他們的閱讀體驗，這激勵了將書籍與情緒匹配音樂配對的推薦系統。<lb/>在這方面，我們提出了情感感知生成對抗網絡跨域推薦（SAGA-CDR），這是一種兩階段的跨域推薦框架，旨在個性化音樂建議並使其與正在閱讀的書籍情感上保持一致。<lb/>在第一階段，基於Transformer的情感嵌入從用戶評論中構建，並通過條件生成對抗網絡在不同領域之間進行映射，其掩碼條件生成器處理缺失的情感組件並注入隨機性以實現更豐富的偏好轉移。<lb/>然後，一個緊湊的評分神經網絡融合了特定情感的互動分數與協同過濾，以預測音樂評分。<lb/>在第二階段，大型語言模型將每本書分類到一個價值-喚醒情感象限中，並篩選候選曲目以匹配該象限。<lb/>在英語亞馬遜和中文豆瓣數據集上的實驗顯示，SAGA-CDR在亞馬遜上實現了最佳的評分預測準確性（RMSE 0.98），並在豆瓣上達到了最低的RMSE（0.91），其排名表現與最強的情感感知基準相媲美，即使在跨語言環境中也是如此。
2610.06703.author: Manousos Linardakis et.al.
